author: CNN
description:
After talks with Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio, leaders from Denmark and Greenland said a “fundamental disagreement” remains with the Trump administration over the territory’s future. The meeting followed President Donald Trump’s remark that “anything less” than US control of Greenland is “unacceptable.”        
    
                                                                                                                                                                                  #News #greenland  #denmark
title: Danish, Greenlandic leaders: 'Fundamental disagreement' with Trump admin after WH visit

description: Italian influencer Chiara Ferragni has been absolved of charges for aggravated fraud in relation to a Christmas cake scandal. The fashion blogger turned influencer was facing a prison sentence of one year and eight months. A Milan judge ruled that the charges were not admissible in court. Chiara Ferragni denied any wrongdoing.
